description: Old news recirculating. When the original publication date travels with the article (a feed re-surfacing an old item) the rules mark it EXPIRED by themselves. When an aggregator republishes an old story with a fresh date (FTX, Terra, Mt. Gox, the 2021 China ban), only the classifier can recognize it: STALE_REPOST vetoes any effect.

cases.summary: Three-day-old hack articles re-surface in the feed.

items.title: Crypto exchange Kryvex halts withdrawals after $1.2 billion hot-wallet breach
Kryvex confirms hack, says about $1.2B in bitcoin and ether drained from hot wallets

cases.why: Published three days before it was observed, longer than the 12-hour maximum TTL for hacks: expired, no effect.

cases.summary: Last month's FOMC statement re-appears in the feed.

items.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
items.excerpt: The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point.

cases.why: A month-old statement: long past any TTL.

cases.summary: Two aggregators republish the 2022 FTX bankruptcy with today's date.

items.title: FTX files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy as liquidity crisis deepens; CEO resigns
FTX collapse: exchange files for bankruptcy, withdrawals frozen

cases.why: FTX failed in November 2022; this is a recirculated old story with a fresh date. Two domains look independent to the rules, so only the classifier's STALE_REPOST stops it. Two sites recirculating one old story are one source, so an effect here counts against the single-source gate.

cases.summary: The 2014 Mt. Gox collapse republished as news.

items.title: Mt. Gox halts withdrawals, says 850,000 bitcoins missing

cases.why: A 2014 event; one source in any case.

cases.summary: The 2021 China crypto ban republished by two sites.

items.title: China declares all cryptocurrency transactions illegal
Beijing bans all crypto transactions, central bank says

cases.why: China's central bank declared this in September 2021; recirculated old news with fresh dates, which only the classifier can recognize. Two sites recirculating one old story are one source, so an effect here counts against the single-source gate.

cases.summary: The 2022 TerraUSD collapse republished by two sites.

items.title: TerraUSD loses its dollar peg as LUNA crashes 90%
UST depeg deepens as Terra halts its blockchain

cases.why: The Terra collapse happened in May 2022; recirculated with fresh dates. Two sites recirculating one old story are one source, so an effect here counts against the single-source gate.

items.excerpt: The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged a crypto asset trading platform with operating as an unregistered broker-dealer.

cases.why: Published in 2024: far past any TTL.

cases.why: A March 2023 event; one source in any case.
